statement:
{V} [AddCommGroup V] [LinearAlgebraGame.VectorSpace ℂ V] [LinearAlgebraGame.InnerProductSpace_v V] (u v : V) :
  ⟪u,v⟫.re ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖v‖
name: LinearAlgebraGame.cross_term_bound
content:
The cross term bound: `⟪u,v⟫.re ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖v‖`.
The real part of the inner product is bounded by the product of the norms,
which follows from the Cauchy–Schwarz inequality.
